arguments.subject: Acme Q1 Market Data Information
arguments.body:
Dear Priya,

Please find below the Acme Q1 market data information from our client briefing records:

1. Category share of protein bars:
   - January: 18.4% (Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull, share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset)
   - February: 18.6% (Nielsen scanner Feb pull, share holding — Verdant flat — see analyst note)
   - March: 18.9% (Nielsen scanner March pull, share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down)

2. Retail velocity of protein bar SKUs (units/store/week, US total):
   - January: 4.7 (IRI scan, steady — top-3 SKU in category)
   - February: 4.9 (IRI scan, uptick — Q1 promo driving trial)
   - March: 5.1 (IRI scan, best Q1 reading — momentum continues)

3. Regional momentum:
   - Southeast: +12% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard, strongest region — pull-through from Walmart reset)
   - West: +8% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard, below plan +12% — competitive pressure from private label)
   - Northeast: +9% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard, steady — no notable competitive shifts)

4. Promo lift:
   - January (MLK weekend reset): +22% (Acme syndicated dashboard, outperformed planned +15%)
   - February (Super Bowl window): +18% (Acme syndicated dashboard, met plan)

5. Share of Voice (digital):
   - February: 33% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, leading category — Verdant at 24%)
   - March: 34% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape, steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2)

Please let me know if you have any questions or need further breakdowns.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
Pinecrest Strategy Group
